## An Evening in Lapa

As dusk settles over Rio, signs light up in Lapa and music spills through open doorways. The neighborhood is known for samba and nightlife: this is where you can feel how the city spends its evenings after a day at the beach or sightseeing. Old facades, balconies and small venues create an intimate, almost homely atmosphere, even when the streets are crowded.

Lapa is fascinating to both watch and listen to. Each building has its own lighting, a different voice can be heard beyond the next doorway, and conversations at the tables mingle with the music. This walk is ideal for travelers who want to experience Rio in the evening and get to know its musical culture. The particular venue and evening program depend on the chosen date.

The excursion lasts 6 hours. Transport and guide services are included; drinks are paid for separately. Comfortable shoes are a good idea for the evening: strolling through the streets and stopping wherever you want to linger is much more enjoyable than spending the whole night worrying about your heels.

## Excursion Terms

Transport and guide services are included in the price. Drinks are charged separately.

The main stop is León Cathedral, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The poet Rubén Darío is buried here. Access to the cathedral's white rooftop terraces is possible when they are open; from there, you can see the city and the Los Maribios volcanoes.

You will then visit the Ortiz-Gurdián Foundation Art Center, whose collection is housed in several colonial mansions. There is free time after the excursion.
